title:
Callbacks for {@link Genai.Agent.Dynamic} that update the agent's trajectory.
These handle syncing content from the native `c3DynamicPythonAgent` to the UI-facing Type interface.

Updates include:
1. Step content: Text output generated by the LLM.
2. Target outputs: Objects (e.g., DataFrames, Charts) produced during {@link Genai.Agent.DynamicTrajectory.Step.TagType}.EXECUTE steps.
3. Citations: Sources used by the agent or tools during execution.
name: Genai.Agent.Dynamic.Callback.TrajectoryUpdate
